$comment: ONE TREE. Everything that changes how the system runs is declared here. A group marked shown becomes a section in the sidebar. Types are pyqtgraph's and JSON Schema's: group, bool, int, float, str, list, action, status.
name: quackitect

children.name: shown
children.help: Which groups appear in the sidebar. The gear chooses them.

children.name: log
children.label: lines
children.title: show log / open the log window in a terminal

children.name: home
children.label: home
children.title: home / the engine's own home page, not the project it drives

children.name: init
children.label: plus
children.title: init / make this folder a project, or a vehicle that carries the method

titles.off: hold / stop the agent. Nothing it asks for is allowed until this is pressed again
titles.on: held / everything is on hold. Press to let it go on

children.name: editor
children.label: hammer
children.title: work / open the work editor. Press it again to close it

children.name: mint
children.title: Four words name the work. After the slash goes everything the next hand needs. Enter mints it.

children.name: process
children.title: Which process shapes the token. The choices are the files in src/processes, so the picker cannot offer one the engine would refuse. Closed it shows the name, open it says what the process is for.

children.name: heartbeat_seconds
children.title: heartbeat
children.help: Seconds between heartbeats. A smaller number is taken. A larger one is ignored.

children.name: ready_budget_ms
children.title: ready in
children.help: Milliseconds allowed from the press to a ready agent. Missing it turns the light red.

children.name: detail_bytes
children.title: detail bytes
children.help: How many bytes a token's detail may hold before the save refuses it. A token is a ticket a person reads cold. It may be made smaller and never larger.

children.name: section_bytes
children.title: section bytes
children.help: How many bytes one evidence section may hold before the save refuses it. Name what was built and what the check said. It may be made smaller and never larger.

children.name: pulls_before_hold_is_stale
children.title: pulls before hold is stale
children.help: How many pulls may pass without the holder of a token pulling before that hold stops counting as somebody working. The queue itself is the clock, so a holder that has stopped goes stale after a few pulls by anybody else. It may be made smaller and never larger.

children.name: answer_first
children.title: answer them first
children.help: Refuse every call while the person is waiting to be answered. The engine reads its own log to know.

children.name: guard_projections
children.title: projections
children.help: Refuse a write to a projection. It can be turned on and never off.

children.name: stop_needs_claim
children.title: stop needs a claim
children.help: Refuse every stop the agent has not claimed a sanctioned reason for. The engine names which reasons those are.
